_comment: Build-time origins registry (D-14) for the STABLE channel (D-19) — the public default. Consumed by tools/build_catalog.py (EPIC-10) to produce the consolidated atari-st/apps.json. Sibling channels: origins/atari-st-test.json, origins/atari-st-dev.json. Exactly one origin is official. Add an unofficial creator by appending an origin with official=false and a remote url (HTTP or HTTPS — fetched server-side at build time; HTTPS recommended), e.g. { "creator": {"id":"someone","name":"Someone","url":"https://…"}, "official": false, "url": "https://someone.example/atari-st/apps.json" }.

origins._comment: SAMPLE unofficial creator (fictional) to exercise the provenance UI. A real unofficial origin would use a remote "url" (HTTP or HTTPS) instead of a local "source". Remove this entry + origins/atari-st/retro-homebrew.apps.json and rerun tools/build_catalog.py to take it down.
